function.name: check_appointment_availability
function.description: Check whether a requested appointment date and time is available before booking it.

appointment_date.description: Appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Convert the caller's natural-language date to this format.

appointment_time.description: Appointment time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Convert the caller's natural-language time to this format.

function.name: save_appointment
function.description: Save a confirmed appointment after the caller has provided all required booking details and the requested slot has been confirmed available.

customer_phone.description: Customer phone number, preferably in +234 E.164 format.

service.description: Service or appointment type requested by the caller.

notes.description: Optional extra notes or special requests.
